αἰνέω: (to tell;) to praise, approve, acquiesce in
αἴρω: to take up, raise, lift up
βλέπω: to see, have the power of sight
γιγνώσκω: to learn to know, to perceive, mark, learn
διαπράσσω: to pass over; bring about, accomplish
διασκεδάννυμι: to scatter abroad, scatter to the winds, disperse
δύω: (trans.) cause to enter or sink (dunk); (intr.) enter; get into; sink; set (of sun/stars)
εἰκάζω: to make like to, represent by a likeness, portray
εἰσοράω: to look into, look upon, view, behold
κατάγνυμι: to break in pieces, shatter, shiver, crack
καταφλέγω: to burn down, burn up, consume
κατευνάζω: to put to bed, lull to sleep
κομίζω: to take care of, provide for
λέγω: to say, tell, speak; epic and arch.: pick, gather
λανθάνω: to escape notice, to be unknown, unseen, unnoticed
λωφάω: to rest from toil, take rest
μάρπτω: to catch, lay hold of, seize
μένω: to stay at home, stay where one is, not stir
μαρτυρέω: to be a witness, to bear witness, give evidence, bear testimony
μεθίημι: to let go, let loose, release
μεθίστημι: to place in another way, to change
μενοινάω: to desire eagerly, to be bent on
μετέρχομαι: to come, go among, go after, attack
μεταστρέφω: to turn about, turn round, turn
μετοχλίζω: to remove by a lever, hoist
νέμω: to deal out, distribute; dwell in (country); pasture (flock)
παραμείβω: to leave on one side, pass by
πείθω: to prevail upon, win over, persuade
περάω: to drive right through; pass, penetrate
πημαίνω: to bring into misery, plunge into ruin, undo
πορεύω: to make to go, carry, convey
προσμολεῖν: to come or go to, arrive at
πόρω: pres. not attested; aor. to furnish, offer; perf. it is fated
σιφλόω: to maim, cripple, bring to misery
σκήπτω: to prop, stay; hurl projectile; (mid.) lean on, allege as excuse
συγχώννυμι: to heap all together, to heap with earth, cover with a mound, bank up
συναρπάζω: to seize and carry clean away
τελευτάω: to complete, finish, accomplish; pple. finally, in the end
τεύχω: to make ready, make, build, work
τλάω: to take upon oneself, to bear, suffer, undergo
τυγχάνω: (with gen.) to hit the mark, to get; (with pple) to happen to, to actually
φαίνω: to bring to light, make to appear
φεύγω: to flee, take flight, run away
φθάνω: to come or do first, before others
χωρέω: give way, draw back, retire, withdraw
ἀδέω: be sated with (food), overcome by (sleep, tiredness)
ἀθρέω: to look at, gaze at, observe, perceive
ἀιστόω: make unseen, make away with, destroy
ἀλλάσσω: to make other than it is, to change, alter
ἀλύσκω: to flee from, shun, avoid, forsake
ἀνίημι: to send up; let go, abate
ἀνίστημι: to make to stand up, raise up
ἀναβαίνω: to go up, mount, to go up to
ἀναγιγνώσκω: to know well, know certainly; to read
ἀναλίσκω: to use up, to spend, lavish
ἀντάω: to come opposite to, meet face to face, meet with
ἀντεῖπον: to speak against; speak in turn, reply (aor)
ἀντιάω: to go for the purpose of meeting
ἀπεῖπον: to speak out, tell out, declare (Hom.), deny, refuse, forbid
ἀποδίδωμι: to give back, give what is due; (mid.) sell
ἀποδρύπτω: to tear off the skin, lacerate
ἀρκέω: to ward off; to be sufficient
ἁλίσκομαι: to be caught, conquered, caught in the act
ἄρχω: (to be first) to rule, to begin
ἐκτελέω: to bring quite to an end, to accomplish, achieve
ἐλαύνω: to drive, drive on, set in motion
ἐλινύω: to keep holiday, to take rest, be at rest, keep quiet, stand idle
ἐνέπω: to tell, tell of, relate, describe
ἐπέχω: to hold on; hold out; hold back; adjourn; occupy
ἐπιβρίθω: to fall heavy upon, fall heavily
ἐπικραίνω: to bring to pass, accomplish, fulfil
ἐπιτίθημι: to lay, put on; (mid.) to attack
ἐπιτρέπω: to turn over to, entrust, command
ἐποτρύνω: to stir up, excite, urge on
ἐρύκω: to keep in, hold back, keep in check, curb, restrain
ἐφίημι: to send to; (mid) to long for
ἡβάω: to be at man’s estate, to be in the prime of youth
ἰθύω: to go straight, press right on
ἱκνέομαι: to come, reach, approach; to supplicate, beseech; to befit
ἵημι: to set a going, put in motion
ὀπάζω: to make to follow, send with
ὀτρύνω: to stir up, rouse, egg on, spur on, encourage
ὀχλίζω: to move by a lever, to heave up
ὁμιλέω: to be in company with, consort with
ὄλλυμι: to destroy, make an end of
ὑπεκπροφεύγω: to flee away secretly, escape and flee
ὑπερβάλλω: to throw over; outdo, surpass, postpone
ὑποστρέφω: to turn round about, turn back
ὑφίστημι: to place under; mid. to submit, to promise
ὠθέω: to thrust, push, shove, force onwards
ῥοιβδέω: to swallow with a noise, suck down
